title: Agent tasks: TaskCreate, Approval, Task, Schedule and Inspector (layout and navigation only)
note: UI evidence, kept outside evidence/*/cases/. Completes no P3 case: P3-03 and P3-04 stay open. No task, permission, payment, approval, schedule or inspection result is created or shown as real.
dependency: Branched from work/person3-mobile-ui06-activity-assets (PR #35, open draft, not merged). origin/main is 95e91fb. If #35 merges first, this branch is rebased onto main by merging origin/main; otherwise #35 must merge before this one.
planReference: docs/plans/03 - Android Owner Wallet.md v7.1: P3-03 (task create and approval), P3-04 (Task outcome/authority/settlement/delivery separation, Schedule, Inspector six findings), S4 TaskView/Finding, S5 outcome/authority/action states, S9.3 goal next to signed terms, S9.12 permission tiers
implemented: Agent tasks hub (new, reached from a Home row under the Agent wallet card): 'Tasks unavailable', stated as not an empty list; Browser check and Scheduled payment forms; Service allowance and Liquidity keeper shown 'Not available yet'; __DEV__-only labelled sample tasks

TaskCreate (browser-check runbook): goal kept as a note; page from the manifest target IDs; checks and providers as checkboxes kept in schema order (pageLoad,title,formSubmit; a,b); agent asset DemoUSD or test USDC ('Needs a wallet policy cap'); spend cap; paid attempts 1-3; 10-minute limit; prices 'quote unavailable'; nothing is checked; Review enabled only when goal, a check, a provider and a spend cap are present

Schedule (scheduled-pay runbook): fixed recipient, asset, amount per payment, Daily/Weekly/Demo (fast); demo timing shows an 'Accelerated demo schedule' callout; first payment, window, count; total gross cap 'Unavailable'; 'A missed window is skipped. The agent never catches up by paying twice.'; payment status unavailable; __DEV__-only sample with Paid, Missed (skipped), Due and Upcoming periods

Approval: the owner's request next to 'Terms you would sign'; every signed term 'Not drafted yet' (the service drafts, the phone checks); what the agent can and cannot do; 'Approve on this phone' disabled; edits need a new review and approval

Task (reachable only from development samples): goal as a note; Outcome, Spending permission, Payments and Delivery as separate cards; each payment shows its payment state and its own delivery state; gross spend counts failed deliveries; INCLUDED is 'not final yet'; UNKNOWN keeps the reservation while the recorded payment is reconciled and no new duplicate payment is created automatically; negative form result shown as a valid delivery

Inspector (reachable only from development samples): Mandate service view and Independent report kept apart; independent report 'Not loaded' (mandate-verify runs outside the app); all six categories always listed; state, reason, basis, rule and evidence per finding; assertion-only findings flagged; summary is never 'All six checks passed' unless all six pass on non-assertion evidence; Export evidence disabled

config/taskStatus.ts labels every shared OUTCOME_STATES, AUTHORITY_STATES, ACTION_STATES and delivery state; config/findings.ts summarises findings; state/taskDraft.ts holds the two form drafts in memory per account and network
Segmented gained a 'compact' option for short labels; it widens and wraps whole at large text
fixtures: config/taskSamples.ts: three sample tasks (A fails then B delivers, gross 0.55; negative form check; unknown payment with a failed integrity finding) and one accelerated sample schedule, shown only in __DEV__ builds and always labelled 'Development sample'. Hashes and evidence IDs are words, never hex or UUIDs.
fabricated: none outside the labelled development samples
security: No signing, no native call, no network request, no secrets. Drafts hold only public form text in memory and are never written to disk.
dependencyChange: none (type-only imports from the existing @mandate/schema devDependency; no lockfile or native change)
